people.name: Yajnavalkya
people.known_for: Vedic sage whose teachings on the self and Brahman are central to the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad.
people.known_for_zh: 吠陀时代的圣人，关于自我与梵的教导是《广林奥义书》的核心内容。

people.name: Uddalaka Aruni
people.known_for: Early Upanishadic teacher who taught his son that the self and the source of the world are one.
people.known_for_zh: 早期奥义书的导师，向儿子讲授“彼即是汝”，认为自我与宇宙本源同一。

people.name: Gargi Vachaknavi
people.known_for: Woman philosopher who questioned Yajnavalkya in a famous debate at the court of King Janaka.
people.known_for_zh: 女哲学家，在遮那竭王的宫廷辩论中向耶若伏吉耶发问而闻名。

people.name: Maitreyi
people.known_for: Wife of Yajnavalkya, remembered in the Upanishads for her dialogue with him on immortality.
people.known_for_zh: 耶若伏吉耶之妻，奥义书记载了她与丈夫关于不朽的对话。

people.name: Janaka
people.known_for: King of Videha remembered as a philosopher king who hosted debates of Vedic sages.
people.known_for_zh: 毗提诃国王，被视为哲人君主，曾在宫中主持吠陀圣人的辩论。

people.name: Parshvanatha
people.known_for: The 23rd Tirthankara of Jainism and the earliest Jain teacher many historians consider historical.
people.known_for_zh: 耆那教第二十三祖，许多史家认为他是耆那教最早真实存在的导师。

Magadha.name: Bimbisara
Magadha.note: Haryanka dynasty; a patron of the Buddha.
Magadha.note_zh: 诃黎王朝国王，佛陀的护持者。

Kosala.name: Prasenajit
Kosala.note: Contemporary and patron of the Buddha.
Kosala.note_zh: 与佛陀同时代，护持佛教。

people.name: Gautama Buddha
people.known_for: Founder of Buddhism, who taught the Four Noble Truths and the Middle Way across the Ganges plain.
people.known_for_zh: 佛教创始人，在恒河流域传授四圣谛和中道。

people.name: Mahavira
people.known_for: The 24th Tirthankara, who gave Jainism its classic form of non-violence and asceticism.
people.known_for_zh: 耆那教第二十四祖，确立了以不杀生和苦行为核心的耆那教教义。

people.name: Ananda
people.known_for: Cousin and attendant of the Buddha who recited his sermons at the First Buddhist Council.
people.known_for_zh: 佛陀的堂弟和侍者，在第一次结集时诵出佛陀所说的经。

people.name: Shariputra
people.known_for: Chief disciple of the Buddha, honoured as foremost in wisdom.
people.known_for_zh: 佛陀的上首弟子，被誉为“智慧第一”。

people.name: Maudgalyayana
people.known_for: Disciple of the Buddha honoured as foremost in supernatural powers.
people.known_for_zh: 佛陀的大弟子，被誉为“神通第一”。

people.name: Mahakashyapa
people.known_for: Disciple who led the First Buddhist Council at Rajgir after the Buddha's death.
people.known_for_zh: 佛陀的大弟子，佛陀去世后在王舍城主持第一次结集。

people.name: Upali
people.known_for: Barber turned monk who recited the monastic rules at the First Buddhist Council.
people.known_for_zh: 出身理发师的佛陀弟子，在第一次结集中诵出戒律。

people.name: Jivaka
people.known_for: Physician to King Bimbisara and to the Buddha, later revered as a patron of traditional medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 频婆娑罗王和佛陀的御医，后世被尊为传统医学的守护者。

check.n: Dates hinge on the disputed Buddha chronology; Wikipedia places him in the 5th century BC.
check.n_zh: 年代取决于有争议的佛陀年表；维基百科置于公元前5世纪。

people.name: Makkhali Gosala
people.known_for: Founder of the Ajivika sect, which taught that all events are fixed by fate.
people.known_for_zh: 邪命外道的创始人，主张一切都由命运注定。

check.n: Dates hinge on disputed Buddha/Mahavira chronology (6th or 5th century BC).
check.n_zh: 年代取决于有争议的佛陀/大雄年表（公元前6或5世纪）。

people.name: Ajita Kesakambali
people.known_for: Materialist thinker who denied rebirth and taught that a person is made only of the four elements.
people.known_for_zh: 唯物论思想家，否认轮回，认为人只由四大元素构成。

people.name: Amrapali
people.known_for: Famous courtesan of Vaishali who gave her mango grove to the Buddha and became a nun.
people.known_for_zh: 毗舍离的名妓，把芒果园献给佛陀，后出家为尼。

check.n: Semi-legendary; only 'around 500 BC' is known, tied to disputed Buddha chronology.
check.n_zh: 半传说人物，仅知约公元前500年，依赖有争议的佛陀年表。

people.name: Sushruta
people.known_for: Ancient physician to whom the classic Sanskrit treatise on surgery is attributed.
people.known_for_zh: 古印度医学家，梵文外科经典《妙闻集》被归于他的名下。

people.name: Panini
people.known_for: Grammarian whose rules of Sanskrit set the standard of the language for all later times.
people.known_for_zh: 语法学家，他制定的梵语语法规则成为后世梵语的标准。

Mauryan Empire.name: Brihadratha
Mauryan Empire.note: Killed by his general Pushyamitra Shunga.
Mauryan Empire.note_zh: 被将军弗沙蜜多罗·巽伽所杀。

people.name: Chanakya
people.known_for: Adviser who helped Chandragupta found the Maurya Empire and wrote the classic of statecraft.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐旃陀罗笈多建立孔雀王朝的谋臣，著有治国经典《政事论》。

people.name: Ashoka
people.known_for: Emperor who renounced war after the Kalinga campaign and spread Buddhism through edicts and missions.
people.known_for_zh: 孔雀王朝皇帝，征服羯陵伽后放弃战争，以诏令和传教使团弘扬佛教。

people.name: Megasthenes
people.known_for: Greek envoy of Seleucus to Chandragupta's court who wrote the first Greek account of India.
people.known_for_zh: 塞琉古派往旃陀罗笈多宫廷的希腊使节，写下第一部希腊人的印度记述。

people.name: Bhadrabahu
people.known_for: Jain teacher who by tradition led his followers south to Karnataka with Chandragupta Maurya.
people.known_for_zh: 耆那教导师，相传与旃陀罗笈多一起率信众南迁卡纳塔克。

people.name: Moggaliputta-Tissa
people.known_for: Monk who presided over the Third Buddhist Council and sent missions abroad under Ashoka.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，在阿育王时期主持第三次佛教结集，并向各地派遣传教使团。

people.name: Mahinda
people.known_for: Son of Ashoka who brought Buddhism to Sri Lanka.
people.known_for_zh: 阿育王之子，将佛教传入斯里兰卡。

people.name: Sanghamitta
people.known_for: Daughter of Ashoka who founded the order of nuns in Sri Lanka and brought a cutting of the Bodhi tree.
people.known_for_zh: 阿育王之女，在斯里兰卡建立比丘尼僧团，并带去菩提树的分枝。

people.name: Devanampiya Tissa
people.known_for: King of Anuradhapura who accepted Buddhism from Mahinda and built the first great monasteries of Sri Lanka.
people.known_for_zh: 阿努拉德普勒国王，从摩哂陀接受佛教，修建斯里兰卡最早的大寺。

Shunga Empire.name: Pushyamitra Shunga
Shunga Empire.note: Founded the dynasty after killing the last Maurya.
Shunga Empire.note_zh: 杀死孔雀王朝末代君主后建立巽伽王朝。

Satavahanihara.name: Gautamiputra Satakarni
Satavahanihara.name_zh: 乔达弥补多罗·娑多迦尼

Satavahanihara.name: Vasishthiputra Pulumavi
Satavahanihara.name_zh: 瓦西什蒂普特拉·普卢马维

check.n: Wikipedia gives new consensus c. 85-125 CE; older 110-138 or 130-159.

Kushan Empire.name: Vasudeva I
Kushan Empire.note: Sent an embassy to the Wei court in 229.

people.name: Menander I
people.known_for: Indo-Greek king whose questions to the monk Nagasena are recorded in a Buddhist classic.
people.known_for_zh: 印度希腊人国王，他与那先比丘的问答被记录在佛教经典中。

check.n: Birth year equals the start of his reign (c. 165/155 BC), so it is likely too late; true birth year unknown.
check.n_zh: 出生年与其即位年（约公元前165/155年）相同，可能偏晚，确切生年不详。

people.name: Kharavela
people.known_for: King of Kalinga known from the Hathigumpha inscription, a patron of Jainism.
people.known_for_zh: 羯陵伽国王，因象窟铭文而为人所知，护持耆那教。

check.n: Hathigumpha inscription is undated; scholars place him in the 2nd or 1st century BC.
check.n_zh: 哈提贡帕铭文无纪年，学者将其定于公元前2或1世纪。

people.name: Patanjali
people.known_for: Grammarian who wrote the great commentary on Panini's grammar.
people.known_for_zh: 语法学家，为波你尼语法撰写了权威的《大疏》。

people.name: Charaka
people.known_for: Physician associated with the founding text of Ayurvedic internal medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家，与阿育吠陀内科奠基经典《遮罗迦本集》相关联。

check.n: Dates are very uncertain; estimates range from before 100 BC to c. 200 CE.
check.n_zh: 年代极不确定，估计从公元前100年前到公元200年左右不等。

people.name: Gondophares
people.known_for: Founder of the Indo-Parthian kingdom, named in Christian legend as the king visited by Saint Thomas.
people.known_for_zh: 印度帕提亚王国的建立者，基督教传说中使徒多马拜访的国王。

people.name: Kanishka
people.known_for: Kushan emperor who patronised Buddhism and the art of Gandhara and built a great stupa at Peshawar.
people.known_for_zh: 贵霜皇帝，护持佛教和犍陀罗艺术，在布路沙布逻修建大佛塔。

people.name: Ashvaghosha
people.known_for: Buddhist poet and dramatist whose epic of the Buddha's life is a classic of Sanskrit poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 佛教诗人和剧作家，所作佛陀传记史诗是梵语诗歌经典。

people.name: Rudradaman I
people.known_for: Western Satrap ruler whose Junagadh inscription is the first long inscription in Sanskrit.
people.known_for_zh: 西方总督国君主，他的朱纳格特铭文是第一篇长篇梵文铭文。

people.name: Nagarjuna
people.known_for: Founder of the Madhyamaka school of Mahayana Buddhism, which teaches emptiness.
people.known_for_zh: 大乘佛教中观学派的创始人，阐发“空”的思想。

people.name: Aryadeva
people.known_for: Disciple of Nagarjuna who defended the Madhyamaka school in debate.
people.known_for_zh: 龙树的弟子，以辩论弘扬中观学说。

people.name: Thiruvalluvar
people.known_for: Tamil poet and sage, author of the Tirukkural, a classic of ethics in short couplets.
people.known_for_zh: 泰米尔诗人和圣贤，著有伦理格言诗集《蒂鲁古拉尔》。

Gupta Empire.name: Chandragupta II
Gupta Empire.note: Called Vikramaditya; Faxian visited in his reign.
Gupta Empire.note_zh: 号超日王，法显在其在位时到访。

Vakataka Empire.name: Harishena
Vakataka Empire.note: Ajanta caves were carved in his reign.
Vakataka Empire.note_zh: 阿旃陀石窟多开凿于其在位时。

Alchon Huns.name: Mihirakula
Alchon Huns.note: Remembered as a persecutor of Buddhists.

people.name: Samudragupta
people.known_for: Gupta emperor whose campaigns across India are listed on the Allahabad Pillar.
people.known_for_zh: 笈多王朝皇帝，阿拉哈巴德石柱铭文记载了他征战印度各地的功业。

people.name: Harisena
people.known_for: Court poet of Samudragupta who composed the Allahabad Pillar inscription.
people.known_for_zh: 沙摩陀罗笈多的宫廷诗人，撰写了阿拉哈巴德石柱铭文。

people.name: Kalidasa
people.known_for: The greatest classical Sanskrit poet and playwright.
people.known_for_zh: 古典梵语文学最伟大的诗人和剧作家。

people.name: Asanga
people.known_for: Co-founder of the Yogacara school of Mahayana Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 大乘佛教瑜伽行派的创立者之一。

people.name: Vasubandhu
people.known_for: Brother of Asanga and a leading Buddhist philosopher of the Abhidharma and Yogacara.
people.known_for_zh: 无著之弟，佛教阿毗达磨和瑜伽行派的重要论师。

people.name: Buddhaghosa
people.known_for: Theravada commentator who systematised Buddhist doctrine in Sri Lanka.
people.known_for_zh: 上座部佛教注释家，在斯里兰卡系统整理了佛教教义。

people.name: Aryabhata
people.known_for: Mathematician and astronomer who used place-value numbers and taught that the Earth turns on its axis.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家和天文学家，使用位值记数，提出地球绕轴自转。

people.name: Dignaga
people.known_for: Founder of Buddhist logic and epistemology.
people.known_for_zh: 佛教因明学（逻辑与认识论）的奠基人。

people.name: Varahamihira
people.known_for: Astronomer and astrologer who summarised the five astronomical systems of his day.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家和占星家，总结了当时的五种天文历算体系。

people.name: Kashyapa I
people.known_for: Sri Lankan king who built a palace fortress on top of the Sigiriya rock.
people.known_for_zh: 斯里兰卡国王，在锡吉里耶巨岩顶上修建宫殿要塞。

people.name: Mahanama
people.known_for: Monk traditionally credited with the Mahavamsa, the great chronicle of Sri Lanka.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，相传是斯里兰卡编年史《大史》的作者。

Chalukyas.name: Pulakeshin II
Chalukyas.note_zh: 在讷尔默达河击败戒日王。

Rashtrakuta state.name: Krishna I
Rashtrakuta state.note: Built the Kailasa temple at Ellora.
Rashtrakuta state.note_zh: 修建埃洛拉的凯拉萨神庙。

Palas.name: Gopala
Palas.note: Elected king, founder of the dynasty.
Palas.note_zh: 被推举为王，王朝的建立者。

check.n: Wikipedia says Vigrahapala II reigned c. 973-978.

people.name: Harsha
people.known_for: King who united much of north India, patronised Buddhism and wrote plays in Sanskrit.
people.known_for_zh: 统一北印度大部分地区的国王，护持佛教，并用梵文创作戏剧。

people.name: Banabhatta
people.known_for: Court writer of Harsha, author of a prose biography of the king and a famous Sanskrit romance.
people.known_for_zh: 戒日王的宫廷作家，著有国王传记和著名的梵语散文小说。

people.name: Brahmagupta
people.known_for: Mathematician who gave the first rules for calculating with zero and negative numbers.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，最早给出了零和负数的运算规则。

people.name: Dharmakirti
people.known_for: Buddhist logician who refined Dignaga's theory of knowledge.
people.known_for_zh: 佛教因明学家，发展了陈那的认识论。

people.name: Narasimhavarman I
people.known_for: Pallava king who defeated Pulakeshin II and began the rock monuments of Mamallapuram.
people.known_for_zh: 帕拉瓦国王，击败补罗稽舍二世，开凿了摩诃巴利补罗姆的岩石建筑群。

people.name: Dandin
people.known_for: Sanskrit writer of the Pallava court whose handbook of poetics was studied as far as Tibet.
people.known_for_zh: 帕拉瓦宫廷的梵语作家，所著诗学手册流传远至西藏。

people.name: Shantideva
people.known_for: Nalanda monk whose poem on the path of the bodhisattva is a classic of Mahayana Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 那烂陀寺僧人，所著菩萨行道的诗篇是大乘佛教经典。

people.name: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim
people.known_for: Umayyad general who conquered Sindh in 711 to 712, bringing Islam to the subcontinent.
people.known_for_zh: 倭马亚王朝将领，711至712年征服信德，使伊斯兰教进入南亚次大陆。

people.name: Andal
people.known_for: Tamil woman saint and poet, the only woman among the twelve Alvars devoted to Vishnu.
people.known_for_zh: 泰米尔女圣人和诗人，是崇奉毗湿奴的十二阿尔瓦尔中唯一的女性。

check.n: Dating disputed: tradition and some scholars say 8th century, Wikidata gives 9th-10th century.
check.n_zh: 年代有争议：传统及部分学者认为8世纪，维基数据作9至10世纪。

people.name: Lalitaditya Muktapida
people.known_for: King of Kashmir who won wide conquests and built the Martand Sun Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 克什米尔国王，四方征战，修建了马尔坦太阳神庙。

people.name: Bhavabhuti
people.known_for: Sanskrit playwright ranked next to Kalidasa, known for his Rama dramas.
people.known_for_zh: 梵语剧作家，地位仅次于迦梨陀娑，以罗摩题材戏剧闻名。

people.name: Adi Shankara
people.known_for: Philosopher who consolidated Advaita Vedanta and founded monasteries across India.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，确立了不二论吠檀多，并在印度各地创建修道院。

people.name: Rajashekhara
people.known_for: Court poet of the Pratiharas, author of plays and a treatise on poetics.
people.known_for_zh: 普腊蒂哈腊王朝的宫廷诗人，著有戏剧和诗学论著。

Chola Empire.name: Rajaraja I
Chola Empire.note: Built the Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur.
Chola Empire.note_zh: 修建坦贾武尔的布里哈迪斯瓦拉神庙。

check.n: Reign end corrected from 1120 to 1122 per Wikipedia.
check.n_zh: 据维基百科，在位终年由1120年改为1122年。

Ghaznavid Emirate.name: Mahmud of Ghazni
Ghaznavid Emirate.note: Led about seventeen raids into India.

Ghaznavid Emirate.name: Khusrau Malik
Ghaznavid Emirate.note: Last Ghaznavid, deposed by the Ghurids at Lahore.
Ghaznavid Emirate.note_zh: 伽色尼末代君主，在拉合尔被古尔王朝废黜。

Ghurid Sultanate.name: Muhammad of Ghor
Ghurid Sultanate.note: Ruled Ghazni from 1173, sole sultan from 1203; won the Second Battle of Tarain in 1192.
Ghurid Sultanate.note_zh: 1173年起统治伽色尼，1203年成为唯一的苏丹；1192年赢得第二次塔拉因之战。

people.name: Al-Biruni
people.known_for: Scholar who came to India with Mahmud's armies, learned Sanskrit and wrote a careful study of Indian science and religion.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，随马哈茂德军队来到印度，学习梵文，写下对印度科学与宗教的细致研究。

people.name: Abhinavagupta
people.known_for: Kashmiri philosopher of Shaivism and the leading theorist of aesthetic emotion in Indian art.
people.known_for_zh: 克什米尔湿婆派哲学家，也是印度艺术“味论”美学最重要的理论家。

people.name: Atisha
people.known_for: Abbot of Vikramashila who went to Tibet in 1042 and revived Buddhism there.
people.known_for_zh: 超戒寺住持，1042年入藏，复兴西藏佛教。

works.title: Lamp for the Path to Enlightenment

people.name: Ali Hujwiri
people.known_for: Sufi saint of Lahore, author of the oldest Persian treatise on Sufism.
people.known_for_zh: 拉合尔的苏非派圣人，著有最早的波斯语苏非主义论著。

people.name: Ramanuja
people.known_for: Philosopher of qualified non-dualism, the main teacher of the Sri Vaishnava tradition.
people.known_for_zh: 限定不二论哲学家，室利毗湿奴派最重要的导师。

people.name: Hemachandra
people.known_for: Jain monk and polymath at the Chaulukya court who wrote on grammar, poetics, history and mathematics.
people.known_for_zh: 耆那教僧人和博学家，在遮娄其宫廷著述语法、诗学、历史和数学。

people.name: Basava
people.known_for: Statesman and poet saint who founded the Lingayat movement and rejected caste.
people.known_for_zh: 政治家和诗人圣者，创立林伽派运动，反对种姓制度。

people.name: Bhaskara II
people.known_for: Mathematician and astronomer who headed the Ujjain observatory and wrote classic texts of arithmetic and algebra.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家和天文学家，主持乌贾因天文台，著有经典的算术和代数著作。

people.name: Kalhana
people.known_for: Kashmiri poet whose verse chronicle of the kings of Kashmir is the best early Indian work of history.
people.known_for_zh: 克什米尔诗人，以诗体写成克什米尔诸王编年史，是古印度最好的史书。

people.name: Moinuddin Chishti
people.known_for: Sufi saint who brought the Chishti order to India; his shrine at Ajmer is a great place of pilgrimage.
people.known_for_zh: 苏非派圣人，将契斯提教团传入印度，其阿杰梅尔圣墓是重要朝圣地。

people.name: Jayadeva
people.known_for: Sanskrit poet whose song cycle of Krishna and Radha shaped later devotional art and music.
people.known_for_zh: 梵语诗人，所作黑天与罗陀的颂歌深刻影响了后世的虔信艺术与音乐。

people.name: Prithviraj Chauhan
people.known_for: Rajput king who beat Muhammad of Ghor in 1191 and lost to him at Tarain in 1192.
people.known_for_zh: 拉杰普特国王，1191年击败穆罕默德·古尔，1192年在塔拉因战败。

people.name: Kambar
people.known_for: Tamil poet who retold the Ramayana in a great Tamil epic.
people.known_for_zh: 泰米尔诗人，用泰米尔语重写了史诗《罗摩衍那》。

people.name: Bakhtiyar Khalji
people.known_for: Ghurid general who conquered Bihar and Bengal and sacked the great monasteries such as Nalanda.
people.known_for_zh: 古尔王朝将领，征服比哈尔和孟加拉，摧毁了那烂陀等大寺院。

Sultanate of Delhi.name: Razia Sultana
Sultanate of Delhi.note: The only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate.
Sultanate of Delhi.note_zh: 德里苏丹国唯一的女性君主。

Sultanate of Delhi.name: Alauddin Khalji
Sultanate of Delhi.note: Repelled the Mongols and raided the far south.
Sultanate of Delhi.note_zh: 击退蒙古人并远征南印度。

Sultanate of Delhi.name: Khizr Khan
Sultanate of Delhi.note: Founder of the Sayyid dynasty after Timur's sack of Delhi.
Sultanate of Delhi.note_zh: 帖木儿洗劫德里后建立赛义德王朝。

Sultanate of Delhi.name: Ibrahim Lodi
Sultanate of Delhi.note_zh: 在帕尼帕特之战中败于巴布尔并战死。

people.name: Nizamuddin Auliya
people.known_for: Chishti Sufi saint of Delhi whose shrine still draws crowds of pilgrims.
people.known_for_zh: 德里的契斯提派苏非圣人，其圣墓至今仍吸引大量朝圣者。

people.name: Madhvacharya
people.known_for: Philosopher who founded the dualist Dvaita school of Vedanta.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，创立吠檀多二元论学派。

people.name: Amir Khusrau
people.known_for: Persian poet and musician of Delhi, called the father of qawwali.
people.known_for_zh: 德里的波斯语诗人和音乐家，被称为卡瓦利音乐之父。

people.name: Namdev
people.known_for: Marathi poet saint of the bhakti movement whose hymns also entered the Sikh scripture.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉地语虔信派诗人圣者，其颂歌也被收入锡克教经典。

people.name: Dnyaneshwar
people.known_for: Marathi saint who wrote a famous commentary on the Bhagavad Gita at about twenty.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉地语圣者，约二十岁时写成著名的《薄伽梵歌》注释。

people.name: Ziauddin Barani
people.known_for: Historian of the Delhi Sultanate under the Khaljis and Tughluqs.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家，记述了卡尔吉王朝和图格鲁克王朝时期的德里苏丹国。

people.name: Vidyaranya
people.known_for: Sage who by tradition guided the founders of Vijayanagara and headed the Sringeri monastery.
people.known_for_zh: 圣者，相传辅佐毗奢耶那伽罗的建国者，并主持斯林格里修道院。

people.name: Lal Ded
people.known_for: Kashmiri mystic poet whose short verses are the oldest works of Kashmiri literature.
people.known_for_zh: 克什米尔神秘主义女诗人，她的短诗是克什米尔语文学最早的作品。

people.name: Madhava of Sangamagrama
people.name_zh: 桑加马格拉马的马德哈瓦
people.known_for: Founder of the Kerala school of mathematics who found infinite series for pi and the sine.
people.known_for_zh: 喀拉拉数学学派的创始人，发现了圆周率和正弦函数的无穷级数。

people.name: Vidyapati
people.known_for: Maithili poet whose love songs of Radha and Krishna spread across eastern India.
people.known_for_zh: 迈蒂利语诗人，他歌咏罗陀与黑天的情歌传遍东印度。

people.name: Annamacharya
people.known_for: Telugu composer of thousands of devotional songs to the god of Tirupati.
people.known_for_zh: 泰卢固语作曲家，为蒂鲁伯蒂的神创作了数千首颂歌。

people.name: Mahmud Gawan
people.known_for: Chief minister of the Bahmani sultanate who built the great madrasa at Bidar.
people.known_for_zh: 巴赫曼尼苏丹国的宰相，在比德尔修建了宏伟的经学院。

people.name: Kabir
people.known_for: Weaver poet of Varanasi who mocked the rituals of both Hindus and Muslims and sang of one God.
people.known_for_zh: 瓦拉纳西的织工诗人，讽刺印度教和伊斯兰教的仪式，歌颂唯一的神。

people.name: Nilakantha Somayaji
people.known_for: Kerala astronomer who proposed a partly heliocentric model of the planets.
people.known_for_zh: 喀拉拉天文学家，提出部分日心的行星模型。

people.name: Guru Nanak
people.known_for: Founder of Sikhism, who taught devotion to one God and the equality of all people.
people.known_for_zh: 锡克教创始人，教导信奉唯一的神，主张人人平等。

people.name: Chaitanya Mahaprabhu
people.known_for: Bengali saint who spread ecstatic chanting of Krishna's name.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉圣者，倡导以狂喜吟唱黑天之名来修行。

Mughal Empire.name: Humayun
Mughal Empire.note: Driven out by Sher Shah Suri.

Sur Empire.name: Sher Shah Suri
Sur Empire.note: Introduced the silver rupee and rebuilt the Grand Trunk Road.
Sur Empire.note_zh: 发行银卢比，重修大干道。

Vijayanagara.name: Sadasiva Raya
Vijayanagara.note: Real power lay with Rama Raya, killed at Talikota in 1565.
Vijayanagara.note_zh: 实权在罗摩罗耶手中，他于1565年塔利科塔之战中被杀。

people.name: Surdas
people.known_for: Blind poet of Braj whose songs of the child Krishna are classics of Hindi devotion.
people.known_for_zh: 布拉吉地区的盲诗人，他歌咏童年黑天的诗歌是印地语虔信文学经典。

people.name: Mirabai
people.known_for: Rajput princess who left court life to sing devotional songs to Krishna.
people.known_for_zh: 拉杰普特公主，舍弃宫廷生活，吟唱献给黑天的颂歌。

people.name: Tansen
people.known_for: Singer at Akbar's court, a founding figure of Hindustani classical music.
people.known_for_zh: 阿克巴宫廷的歌唱家，印度斯坦古典音乐的奠基人物。

people.name: Todar Mal
people.known_for: Akbar's finance minister who reformed land survey and revenue.
people.known_for_zh: 阿克巴的财政大臣，改革了土地丈量和税收制度。

people.name: Bairam Khan
people.known_for: Regent and general who secured the throne for the young Akbar at the Second Battle of Panipat.
people.known_for_zh: 摄政和将领，在第二次帕尼帕特之战中为年少的阿克巴稳固了皇位。

people.name: Birbal
people.known_for: Witty adviser of Akbar, hero of many popular stories.
people.known_for_zh: 阿克巴机智的谋臣，许多民间故事的主人公。

people.name: Tulsidas
people.known_for: Poet who retold the Ramayana in Awadhi, the most read Hindi religious work.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，用阿瓦德语重述《罗摩衍那》，是印地语地区流传最广的宗教作品。

people.name: Maharana Pratap
people.known_for: Rana of Mewar who refused to submit to Akbar and fought him at Haldighati.
people.known_for_zh: 梅瓦尔的拉纳，拒绝臣服阿克巴，并在哈尔迪加蒂与之交战。

people.name: Malik Ambar
people.known_for: Ethiopian-born regent of Ahmadnagar who held back the Mughals with guerrilla tactics.
people.known_for_zh: 生于埃塞俄比亚的艾哈迈德讷格尔摄政，以游击战术抵挡莫卧儿军队。

people.name: Chand Bibi
people.known_for: Regent of Ahmadnagar who defended its fort against Akbar's army.
people.known_for_zh: 艾哈迈德讷格尔的摄政，曾率众守城抵抗阿克巴的军队。

people.name: Man Singh I
people.known_for: Rajput king of Amber and one of Akbar's leading generals.
people.known_for_zh: 安伯的拉杰普特国王，阿克巴手下最重要的将领之一。

people.name: Abul Fazl
people.known_for: Akbar's vizier and historian, author of the official history of his reign.
people.known_for_zh: 阿克巴的大臣和史官，撰写了阿克巴朝的官方史书。

people.name: Guru Arjan
people.known_for: Fifth Sikh Guru who compiled the Sikh scripture and completed the Golden Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 锡克教第五代祖师，编订锡克教经典，建成金庙。

people.name: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah
people.name_zh: 穆罕默德·库里·库特布·沙
people.known_for: Sultan of Golconda who founded Hyderabad and built the Charminar; also a pioneer Urdu poet.
people.known_for_zh: 戈尔康达苏丹，建立海得拉巴城并修建查尔米纳尔，也是乌尔都语诗歌的先驱。

people.name: Nur Jahan
people.known_for: Empress of Jahangir who held real power at the Mughal court and issued coins in her own name.
people.known_for_zh: 贾汉吉尔的皇后，执掌莫卧儿宫廷实权，并以自己的名义铸币。

people.name: Ustad Ahmad Lahauri
people.name_zh: 乌斯塔德·艾哈迈德·拉哈乌里
people.known_for: Architect traditionally credited as the chief designer of the Taj Mahal.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，传统上认为他是泰姬陵的总设计师。

people.name: Tukaram
people.known_for: Marathi poet saint whose devotional songs are sung by pilgrims to Pandharpur.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉地语诗人圣者，他的虔信歌曲至今由前往潘达尔普尔的朝圣者传唱。

people.name: Dara Shikoh
people.known_for: Eldest son of Shah Jahan who translated the Upanishads into Persian and sought common ground between Islam and Hinduism.
people.known_for_zh: 沙贾汗的长子，将奥义书译成波斯文，探寻伊斯兰教与印度教的共通之处。

people.name: Shivaji
people.known_for: Founder of the Maratha kingdom who fought the Mughals from hill forts in the Western Ghats.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉塔王国的建立者，依托西高止山的山堡与莫卧儿帝国作战。

people.name: Guru Gobind Singh
people.known_for: Tenth Sikh Guru who founded the Khalsa and declared the scripture the eternal Guru.
people.known_for_zh: 锡克教第十代祖师，创立卡尔萨教团，宣布经典为永恒的祖师。

Maratha Confederacy.name: Balaji Baji Rao
Maratha Confederacy.note: Third Battle of Panipat lost in 1761.
Maratha Confederacy.note_zh: 1761年第三次帕尼帕特之战战败。

Maratha Confederacy.name: Baji Rao II
Maratha Confederacy.note: Last Peshwa, defeated by the British.
Maratha Confederacy.note_zh: 末代佩什瓦，被英国击败。

Mughal Empire.name: Bahadur Shah II
Mughal Empire.note: Last Mughal emperor, exiled after the 1857 revolt.
Mughal Empire.note_zh: 莫卧儿末代皇帝，1857年起义后被流放。

British East India Company.name: Francis Rawdon-Hastings
British East India Company.name_zh: 弗朗西斯·罗登-黑斯廷斯

Mysore.name: Tipu Sultan
Mysore.note_zh: 在塞林伽巴丹保卫战中战死。

people.name: Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
people.known_for: Islamic scholar who translated the Quran into Persian and sought to renew Muslim thought in India.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰学者，将《古兰经》译成波斯文，致力于复兴印度穆斯林思想。

people.name: Mir Taqi Mir
people.known_for: Leading Urdu poet of the 18th century, master of the ghazal.
people.known_for_zh: 18世纪最重要的乌尔都语诗人，加扎勒诗体大师。

people.name: Robert Clive
people.known_for: Company officer whose victory at Plassey in 1757 began British rule in Bengal.
people.known_for_zh: 东印度公司军官，1757年普拉西战役的胜利开启了英国对孟加拉的统治。

people.name: Ahilyabai Holkar
people.known_for: Maratha queen of Indore, admired for just rule and for rebuilding temples across India.
people.known_for_zh: 印多尔的马拉塔女王，以公正施政和在印度各地重修神庙而受尊敬。

people.name: Mahadaji Shinde
people.known_for: Maratha general who restored Maratha power in the north and controlled the Mughal court.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉塔将领，恢复了马拉塔在北印度的势力，并控制莫卧儿宫廷。

people.name: Siraj ud-Daulah
people.known_for: Last independent Nawab of Bengal, defeated by Clive at Plassey.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉最后一位独立的纳瓦布，在普拉西战役中败于克莱武。

people.name: William Jones
people.known_for: British judge in Calcutta who noted the kinship of Sanskrit with Greek and Latin.
people.known_for_zh: 英国驻加尔各答法官，指出梵语与希腊语、拉丁语的亲缘关系。

people.name: Tyagaraja
people.known_for: Composer whose devotional songs are the core of Carnatic music.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，他的虔信歌曲是卡纳提克音乐的核心曲目。

people.name: Ram Mohan Roy
people.known_for: Reformer who founded the Brahmo Samaj and campaigned against sati.
people.known_for_zh: 社会改革家，创立梵社，反对寡妇殉夫的萨蒂习俗。

people.name: Kittur Chennamma
people.known_for: Queen of Kittur who led an armed revolt against the East India Company in 1824.
people.known_for_zh: 基图尔女王，1824年领导反抗东印度公司的武装起义。

people.name: Ranjit Singh
people.known_for: Founder of the Sikh Empire in the Punjab.
people.known_for_zh: 旁遮普锡克帝国的建立者。

people.name: Swaminarayan
people.known_for: Hindu teacher whose Swaminarayan movement spread widely in Gujarat.
people.known_for_zh: 印度教导师，其斯瓦米纳拉扬运动在古吉拉特广泛传播。

people.name: Mirza Ghalib
people.known_for: The most famous poet of Urdu and Persian, writing at the end of the Mughal age.
people.known_for_zh: 最著名的乌尔都语和波斯语诗人，生活在莫卧儿王朝末期。

people.name: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio
people.known_for: Young teacher and poet at Hindu College whose students led the Young Bengal movement.
people.known_for_zh: 印度学院的年轻教师和诗人，他的学生领导了青年孟加拉运动。

people.name: Tatya Tope
people.known_for: General of the 1857 revolt who fought a long guerrilla campaign in central India.
people.known_for_zh: 1857年起义的将领，在印度中部长期进行游击作战。

people.name: Mangal Pandey
people.known_for: Sepoy whose attack on his officers in March 1857 foreshadowed the great revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 印度兵，1857年3月攻击英国军官，成为大起义的先声。

people.name: Rani Lakshmibai
people.known_for: Queen of Jhansi who fought the British in 1857 and 1858 and died in battle.
people.known_for_zh: 詹西女王，在1857至1858年起义中与英军作战，战死沙场。

British Raj.name: Lord Lytton
British Raj.note: Queen Victoria proclaimed Empress of India in 1877.
British Raj.note_zh: 1877年维多利亚女王被宣布为印度女皇。

Nepal.name: Jung Bahadur Rana
Nepal.note: Founded the hereditary Rana regime; the Shah kings were figureheads.
Nepal.note_zh: 建立世袭的拉纳家族统治，沙阿国王沦为傀儡。

people.name: Syed Ahmad Khan
people.known_for: Muslim reformer who founded the college that became Aligarh Muslim University.
people.known_for_zh: 穆斯林改革家，创办了后来的阿利加尔穆斯林大学。

people.name: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar
people.name_zh: 伊斯瓦尔·钱德拉·维迪亚萨加尔
people.known_for: Bengali educator who won the legal right of Hindu widows to remarry.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉教育家，推动立法准许印度教寡妇再婚。

people.name: Dayananda Saraswati
people.known_for: Founder of the Arya Samaj, which called Hindus back to the Vedas.
people.known_for_zh: 雅利安社的创立者，号召印度教徒回归吠陀。

people.name: Dadabhai Naoroji
people.known_for: Early nationalist who argued that British rule drained India's wealth.
people.known_for_zh: 早期民族主义者，提出英国统治使印度财富外流的“财富流失论”。

works.title: Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
works.title_zh: 印度的贫困与非英国式统治

people.name: Ramakrishna
people.known_for: Bengali mystic who taught that all religions lead to the same God.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉神秘主义者，教导一切宗教都通向同一个神。

people.name: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay
people.known_for: Bengali novelist whose song Vande Mataram became India's national song.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉小说家，他的歌曲《母亲，我向你致敬》被定为印度的“国家之歌”。

people.name: Raja Ravi Varma
people.known_for: Painter who joined European realism with Indian myths and made them popular through prints.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，将欧洲写实技法与印度神话题材结合，并借印刷品使其广泛流行。

people.name: Bal Gangadhar Tilak
people.known_for: Nationalist leader who declared that self-rule is my birthright.
people.known_for_zh: 民族主义领袖，提出“自治是我与生俱来的权利”。

people.name: Jagadish Chandra Bose
people.known_for: Physicist and botanist who pioneered radio waves research and studied the response of plants.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家和植物学家，开创无线电波研究，并研究植物的感应。

people.name: Rabindranath Tagore
people.known_for: Bengali poet and the first Asian Nobel laureate in literature, in 1913.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉诗人，1913年成为第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖的亚洲人。

people.name: Swami Vivekananda
people.known_for: Disciple of Ramakrishna who presented Vedanta to the West at Chicago in 1893.
people.known_for_zh: 罗摩克里希纳的弟子，1893年在芝加哥向西方介绍吠檀多哲学。

people.name: Anagarika Dharmapala
people.known_for: Sri Lankan Buddhist reformer who worked to restore Bodh Gaya.
people.known_for_zh: 斯里兰卡佛教改革家，致力于恢复菩提伽耶圣地。

people.name: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
people.name_zh: 戈帕尔·克里希纳·戈卡莱
people.known_for: Moderate leader of the Indian National Congress and political mentor of Gandhi.
people.known_for_zh: 印度国民大会党温和派领袖，甘地的政治导师。

people.name: Mahatma Gandhi
people.known_for: Leader of the independence movement who used non-violent mass resistance.
people.known_for_zh: 印度独立运动领袖，倡导非暴力不合作运动。

people.name: Sri Aurobindo
people.known_for: Revolutionary turned yogi and philosopher of spiritual evolution.
people.known_for_zh: 由革命者转为瑜伽士的哲学家，提出精神进化学说。

people.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah
people.known_for: Leader of the Muslim League who led the demand for Pakistan.
people.known_for_zh: 穆斯林联盟领袖，领导了建立巴基斯坦的运动。

people.name: Muhammad Iqbal
people.known_for: Urdu and Persian poet and philosopher who proposed a Muslim state in north-west India.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔都语和波斯语诗人、哲学家，提出在印度西北建立穆斯林国家的设想。

people.name: Sarojini Naidu
people.known_for: Poet called the Nightingale of India and the first Indian woman president of the Congress.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，被称为“印度夜莺”，也是国大党第一位印度女主席。

people.name: Premchand
people.known_for: Hindi and Urdu novelist who wrote realistically about village life.
people.known_for_zh: 印地语和乌尔都语小说家，以现实主义笔法描写农村生活。

people.name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
people.known_for: Self-taught mathematical genius known for results on numbers, series and partitions.
people.known_for_zh: 自学成才的数学天才，在数论、级数和整数分拆方面成果卓著。

people.name: C. V. Raman
people.known_for: Physicist who discovered the Raman effect and won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，发现拉曼效应，1930年获诺贝尔物理学奖。

people.name: Satyendra Nath Bose
people.known_for: Physicist whose statistics, developed with Einstein, gave bosons their name.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，与爱因斯坦共同提出玻色-爱因斯坦统计，玻色子以他命名。

people.name: Subhas Chandra Bose
people.known_for: Nationalist who led the Indian National Army against the British in the Second World War.
people.known_for_zh: 民族主义者，二战期间率领印度国民军对英作战。

people.name: Bhagat Singh
people.known_for: Young revolutionary hanged by the British, a hero of the freedom struggle.
people.known_for_zh: 青年革命者，被英国当局绞死，成为独立斗争的英雄。

people.name: Amrita Sher-Gil
people.known_for: Painter who blended European modernism with Indian themes.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，将欧洲现代主义与印度题材融为一体。

India.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
India.name_zh: 拉尔·巴哈杜尔·夏斯特里

India.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee

people.name: Vallabhbhai Patel
people.known_for: First deputy prime minister who brought the princely states into the Indian Union.
people.known_for_zh: 印度首任副总理，促成各土邦并入印度联邦。

people.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
people.known_for: First prime minister of India, who built a secular democracy and led the Non-Aligned Movement.
people.known_for_zh: 印度首任总理，建立世俗民主国家，倡导不结盟运动。

people.name: B. R. Ambedkar
people.known_for: Dalit leader and jurist who chaired the drafting of the Constitution of India.
people.known_for_zh: 达利特（贱民）领袖和法学家，主持起草印度宪法。

people.name: Mother Teresa
people.known_for: Catholic nun who cared for the poor and dying in Kolkata and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979.
people.known_for_zh: 天主教修女，在加尔各答照顾穷人和垂死者，1979年获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Homi J. Bhabha
people.known_for: Physicist who founded India's nuclear research programme.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，创建印度核能研究计划。

people.name: Faiz Ahmad Faiz
people.known_for: Leading Urdu poet of the 20th century, known for poems of love and protest.
people.known_for_zh: 20世纪最重要的乌尔都语诗人之一，以爱情诗和抗议诗闻名。

people.name: Tenzing Norgay
people.known_for: Sherpa mountaineer who with Edmund Hillary first reached the summit of Everest in 1953.
people.known_for_zh: 夏尔巴登山家，1953年与希拉里首次登上珠穆朗玛峰。

people.name: M. F. Husain
people.known_for: Leading modern Indian painter of the Progressive Artists' Group.
people.known_for_zh: 印度现代绘画的代表人物，进步艺术家团体成员。

people.name: Sirimavo Bandaranaike
people.known_for: Sri Lankan leader who became the world's first woman prime minister in 1960.
people.known_for_zh: 斯里兰卡领导人，1960年成为世界上第一位女总理。

people.name: Indira Gandhi
people.known_for: India's only woman prime minister, who won the 1971 war and imposed the Emergency.
people.known_for_zh: 印度唯一的女总理，赢得1971年战争，也曾宣布紧急状态。

people.name: Vikram Sarabhai
people.known_for: Physicist who founded India's space programme.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，创建印度航天计划。

people.name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
people.known_for: Founding father of Bangladesh, who led its independence in 1971.
people.known_for_zh: 孟加拉国国父，领导了1971年的独立。

people.name: Ravi Shankar
people.known_for: Sitar player who brought Indian classical music to world audiences.
people.known_for_zh: 西塔琴演奏家，把印度古典音乐带向世界。

people.name: Satyajit Ray
people.known_for: Film director whose Apu trilogy brought Indian cinema world fame.
people.known_for_zh: 电影导演，“阿普三部曲”使印度电影享誉世界。

people.name: Raj Kapoor
people.known_for: Actor and director, one of the most popular stars of Hindi cinema.
people.known_for_zh: 演员和导演，印地语电影最受欢迎的明星之一。

people.name: M. S. Swaminathan
people.known_for: Agricultural scientist who led India's Green Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 农业科学家，领导了印度的绿色革命。

people.name: Abdus Salam
people.known_for: Pakistani physicist who shared the 1979 Nobel Prize for unifying the weak and electromagnetic forces.
people.known_for_zh: 巴基斯坦物理学家，因弱电统一理论分享1979年诺贝尔物理学奖。

people.name: Abdul Sattar Edhi
people.known_for: Philanthropist who built Pakistan's largest volunteer ambulance and welfare network.
people.known_for_zh: 慈善家，建立了巴基斯坦最大的志愿救护和福利网络。

people.name: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
people.known_for: Founder of the Pakistan Peoples Party and prime minister, executed after a military coup.
people.known_for_zh: 巴基斯坦人民党创始人和总理，军事政变后被处决。

people.name: Lata Mangeshkar
people.known_for: Playback singer whose voice dominated Indian film songs for seven decades.
people.known_for_zh: 电影幕后歌手，七十年间主导了印度电影歌曲。

people.name: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
people.known_for: Missile and space scientist who later served as President of India.
people.known_for_zh: 导弹和航天科学家，后任印度总统。

people.name: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan
people.name_zh: 努斯拉特·法特赫·阿里·汗
people.known_for: Pakistani singer who made Sufi qawwali music known around the world.
people.known_for_zh: 巴基斯坦歌手，让苏非派卡瓦利音乐闻名世界。

people.name: Benazir Bhutto
people.known_for: First woman to lead a modern Muslim-majority country, assassinated in 2007.
people.known_for_zh: 现代穆斯林占多数国家的第一位女性政府首脑，2007年遇刺身亡。
